2023-08-28
Claim opened after the insured reported a low-speed collision while the vehicle was parked in a supermarket lot. The
claimant, who is not represented, gave a first account by phone and said they felt neck stiffness shortly after the
impact.
2023-09-24
Confirmed the driver is named on the policy and that the policy was in force at the time of loss. Requested the police
report and a copy of the scene photographs.
2023-09-30
Police report received and the reporting officer confirms the claimant was in the vehicle at the scene. The other
driver's statement matches the claimant's description of how the impact occurred.
2023-10-04
Two independent witnesses were interviewed and both describe the collision as the claimant described it. Scene
photographs show damage that is mostly in line with the impact described.
2023-11-10
Claimant reported neck strain and was referred to a clinic for evaluation. The reported injury is plausible for a collision
of this kind and no earlier injury to the same area is known from the records available.
2024-02-03
Claimant called again to add a few small details about the seating position and the timing of the impact. The core
account has not changed since the first report.
2024-02-10
A neighbor mentioned seeing the vehicle with body damage seevral weeks before the claimed date. The neighbor's
recollection is ucnonfirmed and no earlier damage to the vehicle is recorded in our files.
2024-02-28
Treatment followed a usual course and symptoms tapered off as the claimant improved. Repair estimate reviewed
and the cost is consistent with the damage shown in the photographs.
2024-03-03
File reviewed. Injury and vehicle damage are consistent with the reported collision and the claimant's account is
unchanged. The neighbor's comment is noted but not supported by other evidence, so the claim proceeds to
settlement review.

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
